done_when: A story's plan read stops after two rounds that have no blocking notes on new text, and an edit only below For the builders never asks for another read

findings.body: An upgraded story can pass round three without blocking on a newly conflicting Answers entry. Raise: Functional. Earlier-release notes have no `answers_seen` field (see `tests/fixtures/forge-v1.2.2/src/forge/story.py:249`), so this line supplies `(not available)` instead of an Answers diff. The round-three prompt then permits blockers only for changed text shown in the plan, spec, or Answers diffs. If a story has completed two reads before upgrade and its Answers section changes before the next read, the reader has no Answers diff on which to base a blocking note. The new upgrade test creates its read notes after upgrading, so it does not cover this path.
findings.title: Legacy read notes leave changed Answers text outside the round-three check

stop.reason: Coordinator decision under the owner's low-risk rule (risk 2): from round three, a change to the linked spec or the brief's Answers since the last round also counts as changed text that can block
